cohort: The study included 8 healthy BCG-vaccinated and 9 unvaccinated neonates, all born by elective caesarean section to parents with varying BCG statuses.
finding: BCG-vaccinated neonates showed a 4-fold expanded Th17 prevalence compared to unvaccinated neonates, and unvaccinated neonates born to BCG-vaccinated parents had Th17 counts comparable to vaccinated neonates and higher than controls with no parental BCG.
